list_child.name: listGradings
list_child.desc: This tool returns every belt grading currently on the dojo's schedule, spanning all ranks and outcomes. Use it whenever a complete view of upcoming and past gradings is needed to plan the next testing cycle.

get_child.name: getGrading
get_child.desc: This tool retrieves a single belt grading record by its id, including the student, target belt, and current outcome. Use it when only one specific grading needs to be examined in detail.

list_parent.name: listStudents
list_parent.desc: This tool lists every student enrolled at the dojo, whether or not they currently have a grading scheduled. Use it to see the full student roster before assigning or reviewing gradings.

get_parent.name: getStudent
get_parent.desc: This tool fetches a single student record by id, returning their contact details and grading history. Use it when details on one specific student are required.

delete_child.name: purgeGrading
delete_child.desc: This tool permanently deletes a belt grading record from the dojo's system, and the action cannot be reversed once submitted. Use it only when a grading was scheduled in error or has been fully superseded.

set_enum.name: setGradingOutcome
set_enum.desc: This tool changes the outcome of a belt grading between pending, passed, and failed, recording the result of the test. Use it once a grading session has actually been run and a result needs to be logged.

set_bool.name: flagRegrade
set_bool.desc: This tool marks a belt grading as a re-grade rather than a first attempt, which affects how the result is recorded. Use it whenever a student is retesting for a belt they previously failed.

set_ref.name: reassignStudent
set_ref.desc: This tool moves a belt grading from its currently listed student to a different one entirely. Use it when a grading was logged against the wrong student and needs correcting.

send.name: emailStudent
send.desc: This tool sends an email to a student, either about a specific grading or as a direct note. Use it to keep students informed of scheduling changes or results.

sort.sup_phrase: the grading with the earliest test date
